releases.notes:
Tested in-game: picking up its own crafting table after a task, placing a bed where it is instead of
walking to a far one. The rest is unit-tested.

### Added
- Settings search: a search box on the Settings tab finds settings by name.
- New setting "Wait while this panel is open" (on): the bot holds still while the AltoClef Plus panel is open,
  and AltoClef no longer closes the panel under you.

### Fixed
- The HUD counts food as items (it showed hunger points, e.g. "Food 180").
- The `@gamer` beds step counts to the beds it really collects (11), so the plan no longer says "Enter the
  Nether" while the bot is still out collecting beds.
- Carrying a bed, `@gamer` sleeps where it is instead of walking to an old bed far away (it went 370 blocks).
- The crafting table it placed is picked up right after a task ends too, and recognised even when it appears
  just after placing.


---

**Install:** Minecraft 1.18.2 with Fabric Loader 0.14+. Put the official
[AltoClef v0.4.1](https://github.com/gaucho-matrero/altoclef/releases/tag/v0.4.1) jars and the
`altoclefplus` jar below into your `mods` folder, then press **Right Shift** in game.
Full guide: [README](https://github.com/Creeperhouse999/Altoclef-Plus#install).

AltoClef Plus is unofficial and not affiliated with the AltoClef or Baritone projects.

  touched, and a furnace is only picked up once nothing of ours is left inside. Setting: Carry crafting table and

releases.notes:
Fixes from playtesting normal tasks. Unit-tested only, except where noted.

### Added
- **Swims like a player:** in deep water with air to spare the bot lets go of jump and sprints, so it swims
  instead of bobbing on the surface. Setting: Swim like a player in deep water.
- **Food trip on normal tasks:** starving (hunger 6 or less) with nothing to eat, the bot gets food first and
  then carries on. `@gamer` already gathers its own food.

### Fixed
- Never steps into or onto powder snow (sinking in freezes you) and walks around wither roses.
- After running from pillagers, their area (32 blocks) is avoided for 3 minutes, so the task doesn't lead the bot
  straight back to them. Picking up items skips drops inside avoided areas and no-enter zones.
- The Defending badge showed for any damage (a fall, hunger); now only hostile mobs count.
- Junk thrown into the pit landed on its rim; the bot now aims at the opening.

releases.notes:
Fixes from playing a Create (Fabric) modpack with JEI. Unit-tested only.

### Fixed
- Crafting got stuck on "Waiting for recipe book click..." in modpacks where the recipe book click does
  nothing (seen with JEI and Create): after 3 seconds the bot now places the items in the grid by hand. This
  also unblocks anything that needs crafting first, like `get stone` (furnace) or a crafting table.
- Asking for an item AltoClef can't get (grass block and other Silk Touch blocks, items from other mods such
  as Create) no longer shows "Running" while nothing happens: it doesn't start and says which items it can't
  get.

releases.notes:
New Presets tab with kits, and blueprint blocks for building. Both are unit-tested only so far.

### Added
- **Presets tab:** about 45 ready-made presets in groups (tools, armor, kits such as "Wood tools + leather
  armor", resources, food and base, speedrun) next to your own presets. Click to run; shift-click one of yours
  to delete it, ctrl-click to edit it.
- **Kit builder** (*Make a kit*): pick items from the item grid with an amount (+1 / +16 / +64 or typed), name
  the kit and save it as a preset, or run it right away. The bot gathers everything as one task. Items AltoClef
  can't get are refused with a message.
- **Blueprint blocks** in the build preview and while building, like Litematica: missing blocks are
  see-through blue cubes, a wrong block in their place is outlined red, placed blocks disappear. Setting:
  Overlay: blueprint blocks.
- **Unload** button in the Build tab: takes the selected schematic out of the world view.


---
